timestamps: UTC RFC3339, six fractional digits, uppercase Z
decimal_values: JSON strings in fixed notation; no exponent, plus sign, leading zeroes, negative zero, or insignificant trailing zeroes; zero is 0
integers: JSON integers in the I-JSON interoperable range
null: explicit JSON null where the schema permits absence
unicode: valid Unicode preserved; invalid surrogate code points rejected
digest_preimage_rule: serialize exactly snapshot_schema_version, evidence_profile, canonicalization_profile, source, and evidence
